deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page. It holds two non-mathematical items, written between pages of ellipsoid and elasticity computations.

(1) The top two lines are a commercial or shipping memorandum, not by Riemann's mathematics hand in content. They mention a provenance ('Prov. ... Elsfleth ... Lübeck'?), a number 'A. 167', a date 'v. 1. Dec. 185?', and the London trading houses 'Palmer Mackillop Dent & Co.' and 'Charles Cotter & Sons'. Its purpose is unclear. It may be a note about a consignment or a bill of exchange, possibly a sum in pounds.

(2) The rest is Riemann's draft of his entry for the Göttingen lecture catalogue, written in Latin and then in German.
- Latin: 'Bernhardus Riemann, Dr., theoriam gravitatis, electricitatis & magnetismi mathematicam exponet quinquies h. IX–X; functiones complexae quantitatis variabilis tractabit, imprimis ellipticas et Abelianas, quaternis scholis h. X–XI.' In this version 'magnetismi' was first written after 'gravitatis', struck, and moved to the end.
- German: 'P. [Riemann wird, struck] ... die mathematische Theorie der Schwere, der Electricität und des Magnetismus fünfmal wöchentlich von 9–10 Uhr vortragen und viermal wöchentlich von 10–11 Uhr die Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Größe, insbesondere elliptische und Abel'sche lehren.'

The title 'Dr.' rather than 'Prof.' points to his time as Privatdozent (1854–Nov. 1857), or at least to the 1850s. The pairing of the two courses fits his known teaching of Abelian functions (WS 1855/56, WS 1856/57). The physics course belongs to the cycle later edited by Hattendorff as 'Schwere, Elektricität und Magnetismus' (1876). The exact semester is unsure.

The adjacent pages (elasticity strains and rigid motions; ellipsoid attraction integrals) are unrelated to this page's content. The sheet was apparently reused as scrap.

results.what: Draft announcement of Riemann's lectures: mathematical theory of gravity, electricity and magnetism (5 hrs/week, 9–10) and functions of a complex variable, especially elliptic and Abelian (4 hrs/week, 10–11)
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (his lecture courses are documented in Dedekind's biography and later lists of his lectures)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a biographical/administrative document, a lecture-catalogue draft plus a commercial memo, with no mathematical content. Both courses are already known from Riemann's documented teaching.
transcription_corrections: Top line: the date reads like 'v. 1. Dec. 185' followed by what looks like a pound sign and a superscript fraction ('£ ?/d'). It may be a money amount rather than a year digit, so the year is not secured.
Latin: 'exponet' is preceded by a struck word (possibly 'bis' or similar), and 'magnetismi' after 'gravitatis' is struck. The text reads 'electricitatis & magnetismi mathematicam'.
Latin: 'imprimis ellipticas et Abelianas'. 'ellipti-cas' is split across the line break, and 'Abelianas' is underlined.
German: after 'P.' the words 'Riemann wird' are struck. 'vortragen' is an interlinear insertion after '9–10 Uhr', and a struck word precedes 'vier mal'.
German: the second part reads '... die Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Größe, insbesondere elliptische und Abel'sche lehren.'
